edits.value_json: "The brass bell sang over the hilltop feast, and its tiny notes rolled toward the empty plates like shiny marbles. Aunt Juniper laughed beside Lila at the top, while Tomas gave the bell rope one careful tug."

"Aunt Juniper was waiting at the hill foot with a sore knee. I wish for something quiet, please, she said. Tomas still dreamed of a daring hilltop picnic. Moss hoped nobody would treat him like a cart. Lila tucked a paper crown under her arm and began inventing a kinder sort of celebration."
"Lila tied the brass bell to Mosss harness, then tucked a soft cloth around it so it would not jingle. Moss gave one quiet testing step and nodded proudly."
"Moss led the one-bundle procession to Juniper with the bell muffled at his shoulder. He stopped beside her and lifted his nose, waiting. Tomas began a tiny, silent applause with his fingertips."
